data.title: Hop and Subtract Adventure
data.description: Learn how to use the number line to subtract within 20 by jumping backwards.

challenges.instruction: Put your finger on the number 5. Ready, set, hop backward 4 spaces to see where you land!
challenges.hint: Count your hops carefully as you jump backward one by one, and check where you stop.

challenges.instruction: Place your finger on 9. Count forward 3 hops to the right to see where you land!
challenges.hint: Start at 9 and count three steps forward one by one: hop one, hop two, hop three!

challenges.instruction: Put your finger on 2. Now hop forward 2 spaces to see where you land!
challenges.hint: Start at 2 and take 2 little hops to the right, counting each hop as you go!

challenges.instruction: Find the number 5 on the number line. Make 1 hop to the left to subtract 1, and place your marker where you land!
challenges.hint: Start at 5 and take 1 hop backward to the left. Which number do you land on?
